_comment: Build-time defaults for the Full OET Course and Full Crash Course tiers (owner brief 28 Oct 2026, final v4 pricing brief 29 Oct 2026; contract: docs/FULL-CRASH-BUNDLES-2026-10-29.md in the web app repo). Single source for pricing.html, the profession course pages and the JSON-LD offers. In the browser, assets/js/oet-bundles.js refreshes price, access, counts, badges, names, descriptions and upgrade hints from catalogUrl by plan code and falls back to these values (data-catalog=static) when the request fails. Descriptions are plain text where **x** marks the benefit phrases that render bold (the same renderer runs at build time and in the browser). The Basic English Course is a free gift ONLY with Ultimate. Checkout re-prices on the server. A plan code is key + '-' + profession suffix for per-profession families and just key for the rest.
